builds.name: Reference: AD spell pressure
builds.goal: Reference for Illaoi: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A territorial melee fighter who prepares tentacles and spirits, then punishes opponents who remain near her ultimate. Fix tentacle/Spirit setup and actual nearby targets. Compare a prepared territory with an unprepared chase; transfer damage and repeated tentacle heals must not be double-counted. AD, haste and Black Cleaver may reward repeated physical ability hits.
testPlan: Kit question for Illaoi: Fix tentacle/Spirit setup and actual nearby targets. Compare a prepared territory with an unprepared chase; transfer damage and repeated tentacle heals must not be double-counted.

Start with the early core (Eclipse, then Shojin) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AD, haste and Black Cleaver may reward repeated physical ability hits. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Increases the damage dealt by Tentacles. When activated, Illaoi smashes down a Tentacle that deals physical damage. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Cleaver needs physical damage and ramp; no assumed benefit to true damage.

The route fails Illaoi's stated kit question: Fix tentacle/Spirit setup and actual nearby targets. Compare a prepared territory with an unprepared chase; transfer damage and repeated tentacle heals must not be double-counted.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Cleaver needs physical damage and ramp; no assumed benefit to true damage.
Full cost 16,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Eclipse, then Shojin. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Black Cleaver, Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Illaoi pulls the spirit from an enemy champion for [7] seconds. The spirit can be damaged like a champion, with [0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 + (0.0008) × AD] of that damage echoing to its owner.

If the spirit dies or the target leaves its range, the target becomes marked for [4] seconds and is Slowed by [80]% for [1.5] seconds. Marked enemies spawn Tentacles if possible.

Tentacles will automatically Slam at spirits and marked enemies once every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=4, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds.

Passive: Slam damage is increased by @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageAmp*100@% (currently @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageTotal@ physical damage).

Active: Illaoi swings her idol, causing a Tentacle to Slam forward.

Illaoi draws the presence of her god, spawning a Tentacle on nearby terrain if no other Tentacles are nearby ([characterLevelInterpolation(18 → 7; raw flags preserved)] second cooldown). Tentacles will not attack on their own, but can be made to Slam by Illaoi's Abilities.

Slam deals @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageTotal@ physical damage. Hitting at least one enemy champion restores [5]% missing Health to Illaoi.

Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional [(3 / 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5 + (0.035) × AD) × (0.01)] max Health physical damage. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will Slam at the target.

Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to nearby enemies and spawning a Tentacle for each enemy champion hit.

For the next [8] seconds, Tentacles are untargetable and Slam 50% faster, and Harsh Lesson has a @spell.IllaoiW:CooldownDuringR@ second cooldown.
